Name: Shadow People Wear Familiar Faces
Author: boringvlln
Description:
[size=4]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿.[/size]

[quote]Imagine going down in the dark mines only to suddenly see your good friend! Look at them running at you...[/quote]
This is a [b][size=3]comedy horror[/size][/b] mod. Let out your deepest darkest desire to attack Pierre with a club or run away in fear seeing Jas.

Shadow people use some kind of psychological warfare to make you see the villagers instead of the dark mass they really are. Or maybe there is something in the water... Feel free to speculate.

[size=2][u]Technical details[/u]:
[/size]
[b]Shadow Brutes[/b] (dangerous and not) now use a [i]random[/i] villager sprite (slightly edited/cropped to fit the ShadowBrute standart sprite).

Because it is technically a separate sprite, sprite replacers for villagers would need a patch, if you want them to look exactly the same as their real counterpart.

[list]
[*]Added a patch for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url] sprites.
[/list][list]
[*]Added a patch for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿ as a separate AT pack.
[/list][list]
[*]Added a patch for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15984]Fantasy Wizard Seasonal Sprite Overhaul[/url]﻿.
[/list]
You can very easily make patches yourself, if it's your sprite or you have a permission (or you only make it for personal use). See the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/1368]article[/url] for guidance. Or you can ask me, I suppose.

[spoiler]
Note: Official DSV patch will not be happening, because Airyn is not comfortable with violent implications. Lol.
Upd: We had the discussion, and it's time to agree to disagree. Communities are not monolithic, people can have a wide variety of opinions. I have removed all additional comments related to this, and will keep it this way. I'd say make [i]personal use[/i] patches and be done with it.
[/spoiler]

If you use this mod together with my other [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12966]monster retexture[/url], don't forget to adjust the config accordingly.

[size=1]Screenshots are taken with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4922]SpriteMaster[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1213]Natural Color - ReShade[/url].[/size]
